title: Affective-ROPTester: Capability and Bias Analysis of LLMs in Predicting Retinopathy of Prematurity

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of emotional framing by embedding negative, neutral, and positive emotional cues into prompts and measuring how these framings alter the model's predictive accuracy and bias patterns for medical risk assessment.

Analyzing the confusion matrices of the models' risk outputs under standard instruction schemes to identify an intrinsic tendency (pessimistic bias) to disproportionately predict medium- and high-risk categories for low-risk clinical samples.
